name: Nepali chat spellings (hand-written)
verdict_reason: Written by hand for this repository, so there is no third-party licence to follow or credit; the app credits third-party sources only.
attribution: A short table of Nepali chat spellings the tables don't reach (ma for म, ra for र, xa for छ, k for के), written for this keyboard. No third-party data.
used_for: The Nepali pack's chatForms file (packs/ne.neopack/chat-forms.tsv): a typed or swiped chat spelling offers its Nepali word (engine/core/src/chat_forms.rs).
